The candidate will work closely with Product, Engineering, QA, and Business teams to gather requirements, prepare documentation, and support product development and delivery. Key Responsibilities Gather, analyze, and document business requirements. Prepare BRDs, FSDs, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Collaborate with Product, Engineering, QA, and business stakeholders. Support Agile/SDLC activities, testing, and product rollouts. Perform basic data analysis using SQL. Maintain product and functional documentation. Support payment product enhancements and issue resolution. Required Skills 1–2 years of experience as a Business Analyst. Good understanding of BRD, FSD, User Stories, Agile & SDLC. Familiarity with JIRA and Confluence. Basic knowledge of SQL/data analysis. Good communication and stakeholder-management skills. Exposure to UPI, Card Payments, POS, Payment Gateway, or Merchant Acquiring is preferred.
